products.title: AROEVE Air Purifiers for Bedroom with Aromatherapy Function-MK06A (Black)
facts: AROEVE's MK06 page lists dimensions of 6.1 by 6.1 by 9.6 inches and a weight of 3 pounds.
The official MK06 page lists a 20 dB sleep-mode claim and a room-area claim up to 215 square feet; both are manufacturer claims, not independently tested here.
The official page recommends replacing the filter cartridge every 3 to 6 months and describes a 2,000-hour replacement reminder.
EPA guidance says portable air-cleaner selection should account for room size and CADR, and that no air cleaner removes all pollutants.

products.title: MyHalos 3D Blackout Sleep Mask
facts: The official MyHalos page describes a 3D contoured sleep-mask format with recessed eye cups and an adjustable strap.
The official care guidance says to hand wash the mask in cool water with mild soap and air dry it.
CDC sleep-environment guidance notes that an eye mask can be used when ambient light cannot otherwise be avoided; this does not establish product-specific sleep outcomes.

products.title: Chefman 1.8L 1500W Electric Kettle
facts: Chefman's official product page lists a 1.8-liter borosilicate-glass kettle with 1500 W / 120 V power.
The official page lists automatic shutoff, boil-dry protection, a removable lid, a 360-degree base, and a stainless-steel filter.

University residence-hall policies differ: some permit kettles with automatic shutoff while others impose room-specific appliance limits, so shoppers must check their own housing policy before purchase.
